subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “One week, a sensor broke and reported dry soil even after rain.”?
options: Because the farmer knew the field, he noticed the mistake before wasting water.
Because the driver knew the list, he noticed Ray was still on board and called his parents.
The drone saved time, but the farmer still walked into the field to check soil and plant roots.
After a heavy rain, the small stream near school was full of water.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「One week, a sensor broke and reported dry soil even after rain. Because the farmer knew the field, he noticed the mistake…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Because the driver knew the list, he noticed Ray was still on board and called his parents.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The drone saved time, but the farmer still walked into the field to check soil and plant roots.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「After a heavy rain, the small stream near school was full of water.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「One week, a sensor broke and reported dry soil even after rain. Because the farmer knew the field, he noticed the mistake before wasting…」，答案為「Because the farmer knew the field, he noticed the mistake before wasting water.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Because the farmer knew the field, he noticed the mistake before wasting water.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
